dialogues.speaker: Millhaven Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: "Welcome to Millhaven, traveler — stranger though you may be, you are most welcome here! This is our town notice board. If there's something you'd like to share, feel free to leave a message for everyone to see."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Exit

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The world holds countless fragrances, yet we believe every blossom's scent waits for the one person meant to find it, just as every beautiful memory belongs to the one who lived it."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Welcome to Scents and Senses, where a fragrance meant just for you awaits."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Fresh flowers just arrived. If you're looking to brighten your day, come visit Fragrant Whispers and take a look."

dialogues.speaker: Delicately-Written Message
dialogues.text: "Added by Lilian for Miss Alodia: To help your flowers last longer in a vase, start by trimming the stems at an angle. Also remove the leaves near the bottom so they don't sit in the water and rot."

dialogues.speaker: Delicately-Written Message
dialogues.text: "Most flowers prefer clean water at room temperature. Fontaine's Romaritime Flowers and Lumidouce Bells like it a bit colder though, so adding a few ice cubes can help. Change the water daily and the flowers should last roughly twice as long. — Lilian"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Why is it so hard for me to keep Pluie Lotuses alive?"

dialogues.speaker: Delicately-Written Message
dialogues.text: "Pluie Lotuses are generally quite easy to look after. Mondstadt may be a little drier than Fontaine, but the temperature and humidity here are still perfectly comfortable for most flowers."

dialogues.speaker: Delicately-Written Message
dialogues.text: "If I had to guess, it might be a ventilation problem. After watering, if the extra moisture stays trapped for too long instead of being carried away by the wind, the plant may struggle to grow properly."

dialogues.speaker: Delicately-Written Message
dialogues.text: "But I can't say for sure without seeing it. If you don't mind, bring the plant by and I'll take a closer look."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Wait, they need watering?"

dialogues.speaker: Delicately-Written Message
dialogues.text: "You know what, don't bother coming."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Looking for a missing young female. Has blonde hair, wears exotic clothes. Any information/assistance greatly welcomed."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Please report to Outrider Amber with any information you may have. Many thanks!"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Looking for a missing young male. Has blond hair, wears exotic clothes. Any information/assistance greatly welcomed."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Please report to Outrider Amber with any information you may have. Many thanks!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Seeking: 'Vera's Melancholy - The Final Chapter.' Willing to pay a fair price. Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Forget it. I've been searching for it for years too. No one knows if the author's alive or dead — chances are they're dead. If you really want the ending, you'll have to find someone to finish it."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "In that case, how about you write 'Vera's Melancholy - The Final Chapter.' Thanks in advance."
